verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents a log streaming service that exports tenant logs (including auth/admin activity) to log analysis services in near real-time, which covers the SIEM export/streaming part of the story. However, no evidence addresses tamper-evidence (immutability, cryptographic integrity, WORM storage) of the audit logs, nor lists specific SIEM integrations or retention guarantees. Missing for 10: explicit tamper-evident/immutable log guarantees, named SIEM integrations (e.g., Splunk, Datadog, Sumo Logic), and independent verification of log integrity.
